apply.confirm.body: The server is stopped, backed up and restarted; the start is verified. If it does not come up, the previous selection is restored.
apply.confirm.title: Apply the mod selection?
apply.label: Apply
apply.started: Operation started — the progress is shown at the top.
avorion.blocked: Clear the blockers above first — otherwise nobody can get in any more.
avorion.confirm.body: The server is backed up, stopped and restarted, and the boot is checked. If it does not come up, the previous list is restored.
avorion.confirm.title: Apply the mod list?
avorion.empty: No mods listed — the server runs unchanged.
avorion.hint: Avorion downloads the mods itself at the next start. The other players need them too — the client also fetches them automatically as soon as it joins.
avorion.notAnId: That does not look like a Workshop ID — paste a number or a Workshop address.
files.blocked: Locked as long as the planned selection contains an error — deselecting lifts the lock.
files.noChange: No change compared to the running server.
files.removeBlocked: This file is live. Deselect it and apply first — then preflight, mandatory backup and boot proof take effect.
files.uploadNote: Stored disabled ({{directory}}) — the running server stays untouched. Expected type: {{loader}}.
reforger.alreadyListed: This mod is already in the list.
reforger.guidHint: The 16-character GUID is in the Workshop URL. Order = load order (dependencies first); the presets below set the right order automatically.
reforger.modeSwitched: Mode switched — the old save is backed up, the server is restarting.
reforger.noScenario: — no scenario set (choose a preset below) —
reforger.preset.confirm.bodyBundle: Adds the mods of this bundle (in the correct load order). A restart is needed afterwards.
reforger.preset.confirm.bodyMode: Switches the game mode. Your current save is backed up automatically and the save of this mode is loaded (or started fresh). The server restarts briefly (~30 s).
reforger.preset.confirm.title: Apply the preset “{{label}}”?
reforger.restartNeeded: Change saved — restart needed so that the server loads the mods (Reforger downloads the Workshop mods at start).
remove.confirm.body: The file is set aside, not deleted — afterwards it sits in a folder of its own next to the mod directory and is removed for good after 30 days. The running server is not touched.
remove.confirm.title: Remove “{{name}}”?
